lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

A Russian man who prosecutors say was recruited by his government has been charged with stalking employees of a Silicon Valley technology and defence company in order to gather intelligence, the Justice Department said Wednesday.
“Grand Theft Auto” has never been much for following the rules, The Associated Press reports.
Anthropic’s hotly anticipated IPO is expected to put it in the top 10 most valuable US companies, but the future is uncertain, BBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
